findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Inspector observed single-service cups in a box on the floor in dry storage. Inspector educated PIC on the importance of keeping single-service cups. Cups were lifted off of the floor and on to pallets. 

(A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE.
Ceiling tiles present in bathrooms are acoustic tiles, observed from pre-opening. PIC stated new tiles have been ordered, but are on back order. Ensure tiles are replaced by next routine inspection with smooth and easily cleanable ones.
